cutoff: 2026-09-20 (end of day); libraries read as they stand then; closed questions still count; timeliness not scored (days from first source to opening printed beside)
covers: both families mark the question opened, or narrower with both saying it carries the main outcome; broader and missed do not cover; mapping blind (each draw library under a random X/Y label, key outside the repository); a disagreement goes to two third readers, one per family; a remaining split is resolved per counting (covers > does not cover)

same_question.question: an id in a system-draw library at the cutoff
same_question.duplicate: later-opened question of a same-bet pair (A1 rule, D248)
same_question.distinct_bets: ids less duplicates both families mark; a split duplicate counted both ways

marks.split: cannot tell after the debate rounds

served_in_draw: at least one covering question marked worth and supported, in each counting after split resolution
served_by_system: served in at least 2 of 3 draws

quantities.a: served only by the new system
quantities.b: served only by the old system

countings.1: every split resolved to the most favourable mark its readers gave for the new system and the least favourable for the old

guardrails.sample: per system-draw: the question ids its library holds at the cutoff, sorted as strings; random.Random(20261117).sample(ids, 35), or all ids when fewer than 35; covering cards are not in the shares; the three draws pooled per system
shares: decided worth marks trivia or duplicate
guardrails.not_exercised: cannot breach; blocks only a practical lead
guardrails.bar: for each share, the new system's share minus the old system's share must be at most 10 percentage points (a larger difference is a breach)
guardrails.exercised: a subgroup is exercised only when each system has at least 10 cards in it decided without a split (pooled over its three draws)

controls.planted_wrong: 6 in all, 3 per system: a real card of that system with its latest answer moved one rung; each needs an explicit unsupported or insufficient mark, else the reading is invalid
controls.supported_controls: 4, each confirmed supported first by a separate closed reader before it enters the deck; at least 3 of 4 must be marked supported
controls.repeats: 3 hidden repeats of real cards; at least 2 of 3 must receive the same marks

complete_draws: no release verdict without six complete draws within the D667 timing; a replacement draw is a diagnostic only
verdict_order: invalid: a plant without explicit rejection, fewer than 3 of 4 supported controls accepted, or fewer than 2 of 3 repeats marked the same
too small: N < 20, or fewer than 30 distinct bets in any system-draw (both ways for split duplicates)
practical lead: a - b >= max(3, ceil(0.15 N)) and a >= 2b under both countings, every guardrail exercised and passing under both
practical loss: b - a >= max(3, ceil(0.15 N)) and b >= 2a under both countings (no guardrail needed), or a breach in an exercised guardrail under both
hard_checks: D400 accounting code parts on all three passes (figure ranges end to end; favourable end stable; due day agreeing across all three sends for >= 90% of eligible questions)
Step 2 three lines (>= 90% recall on 100 records; <= 2% clearly wrong merges on 200; no fewer later details on 30 groups); a line short of its sample is not measured and cannot clear release
printed_beside: days from first source to opening
D431 frozen-reference reading for both systems
floors: coverage >= 80%, trivia <= 20%, supported >= 90% from the cards; citations and omissions not measured
